page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top left. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the lower left.

main_text.p: sti ab ipsomet Domino appellantur: delatum est hoc postea, quicquid est honoris & reuerentiæ, Christi verbo in Ecclesia, ut corpus & sanguis Do-mini etiam ἄνευ συμπλοκῆς [?] pro pane & vino Eucharistico, à consecratione maximè, ponerentur. Itaque formu-lis loquendi in primitiua Ecclesia re-ceptis, corpus Christi dicebatur iace-re in mensa, cadere de altari, manibus sacerdotis teneri, gestari, frangi, &c. vbi nimirum panis consecratus, licet nominatim non expressus, intellige-batur tamen: quia videlicet in prima sacra cœna corporis Christi nomẽ pa-ni esset attributum. Nihil ergo minus antiqui & orthodoxi patres sic hono-rificè de pane & vino consecrato lo-quentes, cogitarũt, quàm substantias panis & vini in vsu Eucharistiæ abii-cere, extrudere, negare: aut in substan-tias corporis & sanguinis Christi con-uertere, aut illa inter se colligare: ve-rum ut ostenderent quanto honori-ficentius de visibilibus elementis, post-

page.notes: The Greek phrase ἄνευ συμπλοκῆς is hard to read at this resolution; the accents and letters are uncertain, so it is marked [?]. The signature "b i" at the lower left is faint and marked [?]. The catchword "post-" is set at the lower right, below the last full line. The faint marks at the far right edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. The text starts mid-sentence, so the opening paragraph continues from the previous page.
